text:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired INF-4232 — embeddings-eu-5xx (severity: P1). Auto‑page -> oncall. Link: https://pd/redwood/INC-4232
pagerduty: Page created by alert: embeddings-service > 5xx rate > 5% in eu-central. Escalation policy: oncall-sre
ashley: acked in PD, I'm on it for initial triage.
ashley: seeing ~6.8% 5xx over last 2m in eu, spike started ~02:07 UTC.
lee: noticed a batcher rollout at 02:05 from canary -> stable, could be related.
sam: any customer facing errors yet? logs?
ashley: some webhooks returning 502s. Early sample: customer IDs (redacted) — small subset but increasing.
ashley: quick check `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=embeddings -o jsonpath='{.items[*].status.phase}'` -> some CrashLoopBackOff
jin: jumping in to help — grabbing metrics + pod logs. I'll try warm pool + restart first.
incidentbot: autoscaler triggered +3 replicas in eu-central at 1830001124, cooldown 120s.
lee: if restarts don't help, fallback routing to eu-fallback-model (v2-quant) is low-risk. Can route at load-balancer level.
sam: tagging support to inform CS but hold public comms until impact scope confirmed.
ashley: plan: roll back batcher change, restart embeddings pods, monitor 200/5xx rate. Handing to jin for the restart. If progress stalls I'll hand back.
jin: executing rollback and rolling restart now: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/batcher --namespace=inference && kubectl rollout restart deploy/embeddings`
jin: logs show repeated `OOMKilled` on embedder-2, memory spikes before crash (heap growth).
lee: could be memory regression in the batcher; temporary knob: reduce max_batch_size and enable quant profile to lower mem.
sam: SLO impact estimate?
ashley: preliminary: ~2% of total customers seeing errors, mostly EU region; latency for others increased slightly.
jin: applied restart and reduced max_batch_size to 256 on the deploy. Watching.
jin: starting reroute for 10% of traffic to us-west fallback to reduce pressure.
ashley: acknowledged handoff — @jin taking over. I'll standby for customer updates. :thumbsup:
jin: hotpatch applied, pods coming up healthy. 5xx dropped to ~1.2% in the last minute. Continuing monitoring.
lee: recommend opening quick rollback PR for the batcher change and schedule post-incident revert if confirmed.
sam: CS notified of impacted customers list, preparing targeted messages if errors persist.
ashley: if stable in 15m we can close PD page and create follow-up for postmortem + RCA.
jin: agreed. Will keep this thread updated, running memory profiling snapshot on one of the embedder pods.
incidentbot: PD page INF-4232 set to status: acknowledged at 1830001128.
ashley: thanks team. Leaving note in incident board and will follow up with timeline.
jin: memory profile shows native allocation spike during batch merge path — collecting traces for devs.
jin: will continue to tail logs and escalate to eng-ml if tracing confirms leak.
ashley: marking as monitoring. If regressions repeat I'll re-open PD.
incidentbot: Page resolved/closed at 1830001150 (closed by auto-close rule after sustained below-threshold).
sam: adding postmortem template entry, assigning to eng-ml + runtime for full RCA.
lee: filing rollback PR now and tagging reviewers.
ashley: closing this thread — follow up in #postmortems with timeline and impact numbers. Good catch everyone. :white_check_mark:
